what_it_is: Antidote Magazine is a French fashion and culture title built around long interviews and photographic series with musicians, writers, actors and public figures, mostly from the French rap and pop scene, shot in a consistent black-and-white portrait style. Since 2026 each issue comes in two formats: a large 30 x 40 cm 'Revue' of 128 pages and a cheaper pocket 'Fanzine', each with several alternative covers but the same contents. It is for French-speaking readers who follow music, fashion and youth culture and like a collectible printed object.
